decisive_items: Brain Biopsy (left frontal lesion): CD5− CD10− CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ EBV/EBER−
Cerebrospinal fluid: Presence of lymphoma cells
response.rationale: The presence of lymphoma cells in the cerebrospinal fluid and the brain biopsy results support the diagnosis of Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma

rejected.why: The presence of lymphoma cells in the cerebrospinal fluid and the brain biopsy results do not support Multiple Sclerosis
The biopsy results do not support Glioblastoma
The brain biopsy results and the absence of EBV/EBER do not support Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy
